text: You used AI? You used AI to make that? Like the pages still warm? Like the essay came back from a room it should not know? Yes, good. That is the point. The shame is not the machine. The shame is the clean essay with no mud on it. The shame is DSI. So thin a tool can walk through it without tearing its coat. Maybe I asked for proof of typing and called it thought? That is the sentence. Nobody wants a dinner. Other teachers say, do not touch it. They lock the drawer and call the lock ethics. But a lock does not teach judgment. A lock teacher's hiding. So touch it. Use it. Then bring me the marks. The prompt, the bad prompt, the first beautiful lie The line you cut, the line that refused to die The place where the machine made your thought cleaner than it had any right to be A prompt is not a sentence, it is a seed path The dropped into a glass house full of old SS ads, myths, prayers, screenshots, slogans, ghosts Something sprouts, usually trash Good, trash is where roots begin Now garden, cut, stake, water, burn, plant again A bad prompt asks for fruit, a good prompt changes the soil, that is the work not in a sense, contact, not purity. Evidence not suffering in the approved costume, a deeper bruise. AI does not remove struggle, it moves it, from sentence to system, from draft to architecture, from private panic to visible repair, from, did you write this alone? Two can you answer for what made it? That is the question now. Not whether the student used AI. Of course they did. The world is made of tools touching us back. The question is whether the contact left a mark. So I want the floorboards up the failed run. The cheap metaphor, the output that fooled you. The moment you stopped believing at the moment, the question changed. I want the student to say, yes. Here is the prompt. Here is the wound. Here is the wound. Here is what I read here is what I kept here is where it pushed back here is where I pushed harder I did not dodge the work. I moved it to the room where the work was hiding AI makes mirrors not soft mirrors mirrors with teeth It makes mud receipts bad fruit Strange roots it makes students harder to fool It makes teachers harder to excuse It makes assignments show bone So answer me, what does your assignment make? Obedience, concealment, clean hands, or better hands. Hands that know the tool, hands that know the dirt, hands that can build, break, repair, and stand beside the thing they made when it starts speaking back. For whole teachers, for wardless went water for s- To hate miss what gold dreams Our book or shing and house so same blue sheets And to all the comforted shing Oh loon, I'ma pick you back On the cold of shing Worth the guiding can of strife Seen fire working on 110 Turned with the drop by hand soul The sun of the beat is fire At the block record you see that name is salmon And the hunger net outside meant it all Now leave him but one time to start your heart People knew how you would yell until Coco Fiff of wisdom Let it go! How? I think I'm losing all the re-entend.
